lead: A `ParseError`'s `issues` come in *name* order from a shape door and in *declaration* order from a class door
body: , so an expectation written from the shape written at the call site is red for any field set that is not already alphabetical. `Core\Arr::shapeAs<{ok: int, bad: int, alsoOk: string, alsoBad: bool}>` reports `alsoBad` before `bad`, while a `#[Core\Json\Derive]` class declaring `zeta, alpha, mid` reports them in exactly that order. Run the program before writing the `--EXPECT--` block, and name fields whose two orders differ when the order is what a case pins.
